2610.02527.title: CriticHack: Evaluating Visual Rewards Under Robot Policy Optimization
2610.02527.paper_summary: Learned visual reward models are increasingly used to optimize robot policies, yet a reward model can score an execution that acts on the wrong object as highly as one that completes the task. We show that optimizing such a reward can amplify these wrong-object failures while reward and task success both rise, so the signals a practitioner would normally monitor look healthy. We fine-tune every denoiser parameter of a diffusion policy against Robometer on a drawer task. Starting from a supervised policy with no prior reward exposure, five training runs raise task success by 10.2 percentage points and wrong-object failures by 10.9 points on 512 evaluation seeds, whereas five runs trained on the simulator's task-completion signal raise success without amplifying wrong-object failures (difference 9.2 points, 95% CI 5.6 to 13.0). The amplification recurs from a policy previously optimized against learned rewards, under the policy's native diffusion sampler, at matched distance from the initial policy, and across constrained-policy experiments with two critics and two optimizers. A tilt model explains when it occurs: under KL-regularized optimization, an outcome becomes more frequent whenever its expected reward under the initial policy exceeds the population average. Robometer separates successes from failures well overall (AUROC .81) but scores wrong-object failures slightly above successes (AUROC .37), so optimization raises both. The same model predicts the outcome shifts across 26 constrained settings (Spearman .89), including those in which task success falls, and Robometer's own published success-termination recipe inherits the error. A frozen outcome verifier redirects the same optimization toward the requested task.
2610.02527.paper_summary_zh: 學習到的視覺獎勵模型越來越多地用於優化機器人政策，然而，獎勵模型可以對錯誤物體的執行給予與完成任務相同的高分。<lb/>我們展示了優化這樣的獎勵會放大這些錯誤物體的失敗，同時獎勵和任務成功率都上升，因此從業者通常會監控的信號看起來是健康的。<lb/>我們針對 Robometer 在抽屜任務上微調了擴散政策的每個去噪器參數。<lb/>從一個沒有先前獎勵暴露的監督政策開始，五次訓練運行使任務成功率提高了 10.2 個百分點，錯誤物體失敗率提高了 10.9 個點，在 512 個評估種子上，而在模擬器的任務完成信號上訓練的五次運行則提高了成功率而沒有放大錯誤物體失敗（差異 9.2 個點，95% CI 5.6 到 13.0）。<lb/>這種放大現象在先前針對學習獎勵優化的政策中再次出現，在政策的本地擴散採樣器下，與初始政策的距離相匹配，並且在有兩個評論者和兩個優化器的受限政策實驗中都出現。<lb/>一個傾斜模型解釋了何時會發生：在 KL 正則化優化下，當其在初始政策下的預期獎勵超過人口平均值時，某個結果變得更為頻繁。<lb/>Robometer 整體上很好地區分成功和失敗（AUROC .81），但對錯誤物體的失敗評分稍高於成功（AUROC .37），因此優化同時提高了兩者。<lb/>同一模型預測了 26 個受限設置中的結果變化（Spearman .89），包括那些任務成功率下降的情況，而 Robometer 自身發表的成功終止配方也繼承了這一錯誤。<lb/>一個凍結的結果驗證器將相同的優化重定向到請求的任務上。
